Key observation before I even build anything: `vuln.c` reads with `fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), f)` where `sizeof(buf)==64`, so `n` can never exceed 64 — meaning the "vulnerable" check `if (n > 999) abort();` looks unreachable for any file input.
